clo_details: Understand relational database concepts, and foundational knowledge of the SQL language.
Define an overview of what data science is today.
Know tools for Data Science, know how to use at least one tool for Data Science
Understand why we are interested in data science, what a methodology is, and why data scientists need a methodology.
Discusses Python fundamentals, python libraries, API suport for data science
Explain the statistics for Data Science: mean, median, mode, variance, and standard deviation, data visualization, regression analysis
Implement the small data science project by applying Python fundamentals, and Python data structures, and working with data in Python.
